note: Each voice's licence, dataset and training are its MODEL_CARD's own words, read on the date above at the revision below. A voice is here only when piper1-gpl's COMMERCIAL_USE.md lists it and its card's Training section names the base that list gives; a card whose Training section says it is fine-tuned from lessac or ryan, the two bases COMMERCIAL_USE.md excludes, is out, and lessac is the base that kept Amy out of the reference soul. terms, when a voice has it, is a sentence its dataset's own licence file adds to the licence, with where it was read and the date. check.card_problems holds a downloaded card to these words.

voices.name: en_US-ljspeech-medium
voices.training: See: https://brycebeattie.com/files/tts/ US English female voice. Single speaker. Trained from scratch for 1000 epochs on medium quality settings using the LJ Speech dataset. I reencoded the recordings to a bit rate of 22500 Hz so it would match other voices released for Piper TTS.
voices.listed: Voices trained from scratch: Public domain
voices.credit: The LJ Speech Dataset, Keith Ito and Linda Johnson, https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/, public domain. The voice was trained by Bryce Beattie, https://brycebeattie.com/files/tts/.

voices.name: en_GB-alba-medium

terms.text: Any use derogatory to the voice talent is prohibited.

voices.training: Finetuned from the U.S. English hifi_tts_92 base model (medium quality; the voice of Cori Samuel, Hi-Fi TTS reader 92), with MRD and SDP. Default inference settings are noise_scale 0.5 and noise_w 0.333. Requires Piper 1.5 or higher.
voices.listed: Voices fine-tuned from hifi_tts_92: CC BY 4.0
voices.credit: Alba speech corpus, Cassia Valentini-Botinhao and Junichi Yamagishi, University of Edinburgh, 2019, https://doi.org/10.7488/ds/2506, CC BY 4.0. Fine-tuned from a base trained on the Hi-Fi Multi-Speaker English TTS Dataset (see the base's credit).

voices.name: en_US-joe-medium
voices.training: Finetuned from the rdh base model (medium quality; nl_BE, one Flemish speaker, CC0), with MRD and SDP. Default inference settings are noise_scale 0.5 and noise_w 0.333. Requires Piper 1.5 or higher.
voices.credit: Recordings from https://github.com/OHF-Voice/voice-datasets, CC0. Fine-tuned from the rdh base (see the base's credit).

hifi_tts_92.name: en_US-hifi_tts_92-medium
hifi_tts_92.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Hi-Fi Multi-Speaker English TTS Dataset, NVIDIA Corporation)
hifi_tts_92.training: Trained from scratch (MRD and SDP). Base model for finetuning, replacing lessac. Cori Samuel speaks British English, but this base was trained with U.S. English (`en-us`) phonemes, so on its own it gives American phoneme symbols British vowels (BATH words such as "after" and "ask" with a back "ah"). Finetuning removes this: an en_US voice finetuned from it on 0.9 hours matched its speaker's American vowels. For a British voice of the same reader, see en_GB-cori. English diphthongs are merged into single ids (`--data.vowel_clusters '[["a","ɪ"],["a","ʊ"],["e","ɪ"],["o","ʊ"],["ɔ","ɪ"]]'`); finetunes must use the same clusters. Requires Piper 1.5 or higher.
hifi_tts_92.credit: Hi-Fi Multi-Speaker English TTS Dataset, Bakhturina, Lavrukhin, Ginsburg and Zhang, Interspeech 2021, https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.01497, https://www.openslr.org/109/, CC BY 4.0. Reader 92 is Cori Samuel, a volunteer reader for LibriVox.

rdh.name: nl_BE-rdh-medium
rdh.training: Trained from scratch, with MRD and SDP. The audio was filtered first with a 70 Hz high-pass and a 50 Hz notch to remove rumble and mains hum. Default inference settings are noise_scale 0.5 and noise_w 0.333. Requires Piper 1.5 or higher.
